definitions.gloss: additional cost; extra charge; supplementary expense
definitions.explanation: A cost that is added on top of the base price or original budget.

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}はかかりません。
{追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}が{発生|はっせい}する{場合|ばあい}があります。
{工事|こうじ}の{途中|とちゅう}で{設計|せっけい}{変更|へんこう}があり、{追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}が{大幅|おおはば}に{膨|ふく}らんだ。
examples.english: There were design changes midway through construction, and the additional costs ballooned significantly.

notes:
A compound of {追加|ついか} (addition) and {費用|ひよう} (cost, expense). Frequently encountered in business contracts, service agreements, travel bookings, and construction projects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}が{発生|はっせい}する: additional costs arise
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}なし: no extra charge
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}を{請求|せいきゅう}する: to charge an additional fee
- {追加|ついか}{費用|ひよう}を{負担|ふたん}する: to bear the additional cost

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}: surcharge; extra fee — specifically for fees and service charges
- {別途|べっと}{費用|ひよう}: separate cost — implies a cost that is billed independently
- {経費|けいひ}: expenses — general term for costs incurred in business or operations
